preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, HJ calls, CO calls, BTN calls, hero(SB) facing decision

preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, CO 3-bets 9bb, BTN calls, SB calls, hero(UTG) calls

preflop_action: CO opens 2.5bb, BTN calls, SB calls, hero(BB) calls

preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, MP calls, CO calls, hero(BTN) calls

preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, MP folds, CO calls, BTN calls, hero(SB) calls, BB folds

preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, HJ calls, CO calls, hero(BTN) closing

preflop_action: CO opens 2.5bb, BTN calls, hero(SB) calls, BB calls

preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, HJ calls, CO calls, BTN calls, SB folds, hero(BB) closing

preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, hero(MP) facing decision

preflop_action: UTG(hero) opens 2.5bb, MP calls, CO calls, BTN calls

preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, hero(MP) calls, CO calls, BTN calls

preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, MP folds, hero(CO) calls, BTN calls, SB+BB fold

preflop_action: MP opens 2.5bb, CO calls, hero(BTN) calls, SB+BB fold

preflop_action: CO opens 2.5bb, BTN calls, SB calls, hero(BB) calls
